item.title: C_Chinese-Style Mythical Creatures_Generation Of Auspicious Beast Images
item.description:
Chinese-Style Mythical Creatures

LIKE THIS MODEL? GIVE A ❤️

Model Introduction

  • This LoRA model focuses on the creation of Chinese-style mythical creatures, accurately presenting the forms of auspicious beasts in Chinese mythology and restoring the charm of traditional myths.

  • It has excellent ability to shape mythical creatures and is suitable for scenarios such as Chinese-style illustrations and myth-themed creations.

Base Prompt:Mythical creatures in Chinese legends

The red keywords serve as the base prompt​​, followed by character or scene descriptions, which can be expressed in either tag-based language or natural language.

Example prompts used:

  1. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, the red dragon, winding body, flames on scales, soaring above misty mountains, radiating ancient power.

  2. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, golden ox, massive horns, armored body, stepping on cloud - filled valleys, exuding majestic might.

  3. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, purple - scaled beast, sharp sword in hand, leaping over rocky peaks, shrouded in mysterious auras.

  4. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, winged dragon, purple - green plumage, spreading wings above misty ranges, eyes glowing with magic.

  5. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, golden - scaled dragon, twisting body, golden light swirling, coiling around cloud - touched cliffs.

  6. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, lion - like beast, blue - gold fur, roaring on foggy hills, red eyes blazing with fierceness.

  7. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, turtle - dragon, green shell, ancient stone beside it, resting on misty mountain slopes, serene yet powerful.

  8. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, armored tiger, striped fur, sharp claws, prowling through cloud - veiled forests, full of wild power.

  9. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, blue dragon, sleek body, swirling in misty gorges, scales shimmering like ice, cold and noble.

  10. Mythical creatures in Chinese legends, multi - colored beast, unique form, standing on cloud - capped summits, merging mystery and grandeur.

Please enjoy and share your amazing work!

item.title: C_Automotive Interior Design_Diverse Style Generation
item.description:
Automotive Interior Design

LIKE THIS MODEL? GIVE A ❤️

Model Introduction

  • This LoRA model is specifically designed for automotive interior design sketches, capable of generating interior designs in diverse styles and featuring the advantage of accurately presenting details.

  • The model has strong generalization and is suitable for various interior design scenarios.

Base Prompt:Car interior design sketches

The red keywords serve as the base prompt​​, followed by character or scene descriptions, which can be expressed in either tag-based language or natural language.

Example prompts used:

  1. Car interior design sketches, futuristic style, minimalist lines, integrated smart displays, ambient light strips, light gray & metallic accents, spacious layout.

  2. Car interior design sketches, retro - inspired, wood - grain panels, round - shaped displays, plush seats, brown & beige tones, classic steering wheel.

  3. Car interior design sketches, sporty vibe, carbon - fiber details, bucket seats, red accents, digital dash, compact yet dynamic layout.

  4. Car interior design sketches, luxury - oriented, leather upholstery, crystal - like controls, panoramic roof, deep blue & gold hues, large center console.

  5. Car interior design sketches, eco - friendly, recycled materials, plant - based fabrics, digital - analog hybrid dash, green & earthy tones, open - air feel.

  6. Car interior design sketches, tech - heavy, AR - enabled windshield, retractable screens, voice - control panels, silver & neon colors, high - tech ambiance.

  7. Car interior design sketches, family - focused, foldable seats, kid - friendly storage, large touchscreens, pastel colors, cozy & practical layout.

  8. Car interior design sketches, off - road style, rugged materials, grab handles, outdoor - info displays, khaki & black tones, durable build.

  9. Car interior design sketches, convertible - themed, open - sky feel, lightweight seats, wind - inspired shapes, blue & white colors, airy atmosphere.

  10. Car interior design sketches, premium 商务，reclining seats, privacy partitions, conference - like tables, dark brown & cream tones, executive layout.
